s1_headline: Fresh clams can ruin your clam pizza faster than canned ones.
s2_headline: In a 900°F oven, fresh clams overcook almost instantly.
s2_subline: Canned clams are already cooked, so they're actually more forgiving at high heat.
s3_headline: We add fresh clams in the last 20 seconds of the cook.
s3_subline: Any earlier and they tighten up before the crust is even done.
s4_headline: Short on time? Canned clams, no debate.
s4_subline: Bumble Bee or Bar Harbor, drained, finished with a little reserved juice.
